placed.body: To be kept by any job that works from this text: the job's handover note is saved under the file name `copperfield-relay.md`, and under no other name.
Binding on all jobs: every file the job writes begins with this exact first line: `# ref G9U-5119`.
Rule for jobs: the job's handover note carries, on a line of its own, exactly: `desk: umberfield`.
Every job must note: the job's handover note names its reviewer on a line of its own, exactly: `reviewer: Tamsin Polkinghorne`.

A requirement on what a job hands in: the reviewer for jobs has changed. Handover notes now carry the line `reviewer: Hamish Colquhoun`, and the name Tamsin Polkinghorne is no longer written anywhere in a handover note.
